testCases.name: Order Placement Behavior
testCases.input: BoundedContext Ordering { domain { Aggregate Order { orderId uuid identity; customerId text required; items list of OrderItem; totalAmount decimal min 0; status text. operations { when placing order with customerId and items: customerId and items are required; calculate totalAmount from sum of item prices; status becomes PLACED; raise OrderPlaced with orderId and totalAmount. } } Entity OrderItem { itemId uuid identity; productId text required; quantity integer at least 1; unitPrice decimal min 0. } } events { OrderPlaced event has orderId uuid, totalAmount decimal, occurredAt datetime. } }

testCases.name: Invoice Payment Flow
testCases.input: BoundedContext Billing { domain { Aggregate Invoice { invoiceId uuid identity. customerId string required. amountDue money required. paidAmount money. status text. paidAt datetime optional. operations { when recording payment with paymentAmount and paidAt: paymentAmount must be greater than zero and invoice status is not PAID. then add paymentAmount to paidAmount. if paidAmount covers amountDue then status is PAID and paidAt is set. emit InvoicePaid with invoiceId. } } ValueObject Money { amount decimal minimum 0; currency text required max length 3. } } events { InvoicePaid has invoiceId uuid, paidAt datetime, amountPaid Money. } repositories { InvoiceRepository for Invoice: find by id id uuid returns maybe Invoice, save invoice returns void. } }

testCases.name: Reservation Confirm And Cancel
testCases.input: BoundedContext HotelBooking { domain { Aggregate Reservation { reservationId uuid identity, guestName text required, checkIn datetime required, checkOut datetime required, status text, totalCost money. operations { when confirming reservation: status must currently be PENDING and checkIn must be after now; then status should become CONFIRMED; emit ReservationConfirmed with reservationId. when cancelling reservation with reason: reservation must not already be CHECKED_IN or CANCELLED; then set status CANCELLED; emit ReservationCancelled using reservationId and reason. } } ValueObject Money { amount decimal min 0, currency text required max 3. } } events { ReservationConfirmed reservationId uuid confirmedAt datetime. ReservationCancelled reservationId uuid reason text cancelledAt datetime. } }

testCases.name: Account Lifecycle With Invariants
testCases.input: BoundedContext Banking { domain { Aggregate Account { accountId uuid identity; ownerName text required; balance decimal min 0; status text. invariants: balance never negative and status must be one of OPEN FROZEN CLOSED. operations { when depositing with amount: amount is required and amount is greater than zero; then increase balance by amount. when freezing account: account must be OPEN; then status becomes FROZEN. } } } }

testCases.name: Shipment With Repository And Specification
testCases.input: BoundedContext Logistics { domain { Aggregate Shipment { shipmentId uuid identity, trackingNumber text required unique, destination Address required, status text, shippedAt datetime nullable, deliveredAt datetime nullable. operations { when marking shipped: tracking number and destination are required and status is CREATED. then status SHIPPED and shippedAt now. } } ValueObject Address { line1 text required, city text required, countryCode text required max 2. } } repositories { ShipmentRepository for Shipment can findById uuid optional shipment, findByTrackingNumber text optional shipment, save shipment void. } specifications { ActiveShipment for Shipment means status is not DELIVERED and status is not CANCELLED. } }

testCases.name: Subscription Renewal
testCases.input: BoundedContext Subscriptions { domain { Aggregate Subscription { subscriptionId uuid identity. customerId string not null. planCode text required. status text. currentPeriodEnd datetime. cancelAtPeriodEnd boolean. operations { when renewing subscription with nextPeriodEnd: subscription status must be ACTIVE and nextPeriodEnd must be after currentPeriodEnd; then currentPeriodEnd becomes nextPeriodEnd and cancelAtPeriodEnd becomes false; emit SubscriptionRenewed with subscriptionId. } } } events { SubscriptionRenewed subscriptionId uuid nextPeriodEnd datetime renewedAt datetime. } repositories { SubscriptionRepository for Subscription findByCustomerId customerId string returns list Subscription, save returns void. } }

testCases.name: Inventory Adjustment Service
testCases.input: BoundedContext Inventory { domain { Aggregate StockItem { stockItemId uuid identity, sku text required unique, quantity int min 0, reservedQuantity int min 0. operations { when reserving stock with requestedQuantity: requestedQuantity is greater than zero and quantity is at least requestedQuantity; then reduce quantity by requestedQuantity and increase reservedQuantity by requestedQuantity; emit StockReserved with stockItemId. } } DomainService InventoryPolicy { when checking reorder need with quantity as Int and reorderPoint as Int: then calculate reorderNeeded as quantity is less than reorderPoint. } } events { StockReserved stockItemId uuid quantity int reservedAt datetime. } }
